Container.Name: astro-ingest
Container.Overview: Pulls capture data off a ZWO ASIAIR over SMB, files it onto an Astronomy share by that share's rules (review screen first, checksum-verified copies, PROJECT_INFO.txt and index links), then cleans the ASIAIR with approval. Built around one specific share layout (docs/ORGANIZATION_GUIDE.md): read that before pointing it at yours.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app. 8091 leaves 8090 to the dev container while both exist.

Config.Name: Astronomy share
Config.Description: The Astronomy share, READ-WRITE: frames are filed here, and app state lives in Z95-ClaudeReferences/ingest.

Config.Name: Staging
Config.Description: Frames read once from the ASIAIR, kept until they're filed. Its own share, outside the Astronomy share.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Where you image: night dates come from the ASIAIR's local time.

Config.Name: Allow deleting from the ASIAIR
Config.Description: 1 lets Clean up delete from the device (only checksum-proven or explicitly ticked files, after approval). Leave 0 until your backups are in place.

Config.Name: Home network (optional)
Config.Description: Only to override the detected network, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Normally worked out from your browser's address.

Config.Name: Assumed Wi-Fi speed (MB/s)
Config.Description: Used for time estimates until a first staging run measures the real speed.
